question: Is there enough evidence to select one architecture for C2, or should C2 retain two architectures until a small number of supplier and engineering gates are answered?
answer: Retain C01 and C02 through a small gated C2 comparison; do not select a sole architecture yet.
C02_A6F1: ADVANCE CONDITIONALLY as common-LOS challenger, subject to annular-primary, dichroic and real-camera/fold gates
C04_N1400_B09: RETAIN as procurement-risk hedge; do not spend another optical optimization run unless supplier evidence changes the heavy/long implementation
blocking_gates_before_sole_commitment: common detector/dewar/window/electronics interfaces and payload accounting boundary
C01 concept CAD/thermal/boresight mass and gimbal estimate
C02 quoteable annular-primary fabrication, metrology, support and finished mass
C02 finite dichroic transition allocation and vendor feasibility
C02 real three-element cameras plus physical folded package
next_action: Issue common-basis budgetary RFQs and obtain detector/environment interfaces; if C02 supplier gates are credible, authorize one bounded three-element-backend and fold run.
